items.liable: The Renter is liable for violations committed while in possession of the vehicle, including when a camera fine notice arrives after the trip ends. The Owner provides the violation notice with the trip's timestamps as evidence.
items.cooperate: The Renter works with the competent authorities to confirm who was driving, pays the fine and accepts any licence point deduction as provided by law.
items.impound: When the vehicle is impounded because of the Renter's violation, the Renter bears the costs (storage, travel, paperwork) and the Owner's actual lost income while the vehicle is impounded, where substantiated.
items.before: Violations committed before handover or after the vehicle's return are the Owner's responsibility.

withDriver.heading: 12. Rental with driver
withDriver.body: For rentals with driver, the vehicle is driven by the Owner's driver and possession does not pass to the Renter. The Owner is responsible for the driver, the vehicle, the driver's traffic violations and the conditions for transport business required by law. The Renter follows safety instructions, does not ask the driver to break traffic law, brings no prohibited goods on board and is responsible for damage they cause to the vehicle. Tolls, parking and other costs on the route are as agreed between the parties.

money.heading: 13. Rental, cancellation and refunds
money.body: The rental, the Hold payment, the part paid directly and refunds on cancellation follow the Payment and Points Wallet Policy and the Cancellation and Refund Policy in force when the Owner accepted the trip.

dispute.heading: 14. Disputes between the parties
dispute.body: The parties first negotiate in good faith. XePrime helps them communicate, provides the trip records and concludes trips within the Hold payment under the Complaints Policy. Disputes beyond that are resolved by the parties themselves, through mediation or before a competent court under Vietnamese law.

validity.heading: 15. Validity
validity.body: The contract is effective from the moment the Booking is formed until both parties have fulfilled every obligation, including obligations arising after return such as traffic violations and compensation. The contract is made in Vietnamese, in electronic form; each party can view and print the booking's records on the Platform.

owner-tax.title: Tax Policy for Owners
owner-tax.summary: XePrime withholds, declares and pays tax on behalf of owners who are individuals or household businesses: the rates, what they apply to, when they are deducted and what you need to do.

basis.heading: 1. Legal basis
basis.body: XePrime withholds tax from owners because the law requires it - it is not a XePrime fee. The regulations in force:

items.nd117: Decree 117/2025/ND-CP (effective 1 July 2025): digital platforms with a payment function must withhold, declare and pay value-added tax (VAT) and personal income tax (PIT) on behalf of households and individuals doing business on the platform.
items.nd68: Decree 68/2026/ND-CP (effective 5 March 2026): platforms with ordering and payment functions continue to withhold, declare and pay on behalf of sellers per transaction; PIT paid on your behalf is credited when your tax payable is determined.
items.nd141: Decree 141/2026/ND-CP (issued 29 April 2026, applying from 1 January 2026), amending Decree 68/2026/ND-CP: raises the annual revenue threshold below which household and individual businesses pay no VAT or PIT from VND 500 million to VND 1 billion.
items.platform: XePrime collects the customer's hold payment through its own account, so it is a platform with a payment function and must withhold and pay on your behalf.

who.heading: 2. Who is withheld
who.body: Whether tax is withheld depends only on the entity type in your seller profile:

items.company: Company verified by XePrime: not withheld - a company issues its own invoices and declares its own taxes.
items.noProfile: No seller profile yet, or a company profile not yet verified: treated as an individual and withheld. Missing information does not remove the tax obligation.
items.track: Being on a subscription plan or not does not decide withholding: a shop that buys a plan but is a household business is still withheld.

itemsInApp.track: How an owner participates on the marketplace does not decide withholding: an owner registered as a household business is still withheld.

rates.heading: 3. Rates
rates.body: The rate depends on the trip's service type and is made of two taxes computed separately. Current rates:

items.snapshot: The rate of a trip is locked in when you accept it. If the rates change later, trips already locked in keep the old rate.

base.heading: 4. What the tax applies to
base.body: Tax is computed on the rental amount of the marketplace booking:

items.included: Included: the rental after any discount you set on the vehicle.
items.excluded: Excluded: the delivery fee (the customer pays it to you directly), the booking fee the customer pays XePrime, insurance and the value of promo codes funded by XePrime.
items.rounding: Each tax is computed separately and rounded to the đồng, so the amount withheld matches the rate times the rental exactly. Example: a 780,000đ self-drive trip is withheld VAT 39,000đ + PIT 15,600đ = 54,600đ.
items.direct: Direct bookings (customers from other sources who pay you directly) do not go through XePrime, so XePrime does not withhold; you declare and pay tax on that revenue yourself as required.

timing.heading: 5. When tax is withheld
timing.body: Tax follows the trips that actually take place:

items.recorded: The tax is recorded when the trip starts, that is when the vehicle is handed over to the customer.
items.deducted: The tax is deducted from what XePrime pays you: when the trip is completed, your Points wallet receives your rent paid in advance minus the tax. Tax is never added to what the customer pays.
items.adjusted: If the amount of a trip changes after the tax was recorded, XePrime records a reversal and a new entry instead of editing the old one.

cancellation.heading: 6. When a trip is cancelled
cancellation.body: A cancellation creates no tax for the part of the trip that did not happen:

items.beforeTrip: Trip cancelled before it starts: no tax withheld.
items.lateCompensation: The compensation you receive when a customer cancels late or does not show up is compensation for loss, not rental revenue, so it is not withheld.

threshold.heading: 7. Revenue below the taxable threshold
threshold.body: From 2026, household and individual businesses with full-year revenue of VND 1 billion or less pay no VAT and no PIT. In detail:

items.amount: Current threshold: VND 1 billion per year, under Decree 68/2026/ND-CP as amended by Decree 141/2026/ND-CP. The threshold is set by the Government and may change; XePrime updates this page when a new regulation is issued.
items.revenue: Revenue for the threshold is your total business revenue for the year, including trips through XePrime, direct bookings, trips on other platforms and any other business activity, counted before platform service fees. The VND 1 billion threshold applies only once to all of that revenue.
items.withholding: XePrime still withholds per transaction even if your revenue is below the threshold: current rules make no exception for sellers below it, and XePrime cannot know your full-year revenue in advance.
items.refund: If your actual full-year revenue is VND 1 billion or less, the tax withheld is overpaid tax. Apply to your tax authority for an offset, a refund, or a refund combined with an offset under the tax administration law, using the withholding certificate XePrime provides. XePrime has already paid this tax to the state budget, so it does not refund it to you directly.
items.above: If your full-year revenue is above VND 1 billion, you are liable for VAT and PIT; the PIT XePrime paid on your behalf is credited when your tax payable is determined. Household and individual businesses with annual revenue above VND 1 billion must also use e-invoices with a tax authority code.

identity.heading: 8. Information you need to provide
identity.body: So that XePrime declares the right taxpayer, complete your seller profile: entity type (individual, household business, company), the name of the individual, household business or company, and tax code or personal identification number (citizen ID number). Wrong or missing information may prevent the tax paid on your behalf from being credited to you correctly; XePrime does not refund tax correctly withheld on the basis of the information you declared.

certificate.heading: 9. Withholding certificate
certificate.body: XePrime provides the year's tax withholding certificate before the tax finalisation period, for you to use when finalising your taxes or requesting a refund. Until then, you can see the tax withheld for each trip and per month in your workspace.

statement.heading: 10. Where you see the amounts
statement.body: In the request approval dialog, the booking detail and the wallet statement, the "owner payout" table shows each line separately: rental revenue, the owner service fee, tax withheld (with the VAT and PIT parts), your income, the part the customer pays you directly and the amount credited to your wallet.

changes.heading: 11. Policy changes
changes.body: The rates and how they apply may change with new legislation or tax authority guidance. Changes are published on this page before they apply and never apply retroactively to trips already locked in.

subscription.title: Shop Service Plan Terms
subscription.summary: The conditions for buying and using shop service plans by vehicle type: benefits, activation, renewal, upgrades, the grace period on expiry, switching tracks and refunds.

scope.heading: 1. Scope
scope.body: These Terms apply to owners who are household businesses, companies or professional individuals buying a shop service plan on XePrime (a “Shop”), and form an integral part of the Terms of Use and the Marketplace Operating Rules.

packages.heading: 2. Plans and their scope
packages.body: Plans are sold by vehicle type and maximum number of vehicles, with a specific price for each term published on the plan purchase screen.

items.byType: Motorbike and car plans come in tiers of 1, 5 and 10 vehicles; the enterprise plan is for larger fleets, sold through consultation at a negotiated price.
items.combination: A Shop holds at most one motorbike plan and one car plan at a time; the enterprise plan replaces both.
items.quota: The maximum number of vehicles is counted separately per vehicle type within the scope of that plan. A vehicle type without a plan cannot be created or listed on the marketplace.
items.enterprise: The enterprise plan follows a separately signed contract; its terms prevail where they differ from these Terms.

benefits.heading: 3. Plan benefits
benefits.body: While the plan is active, the Shop pays no owner service fee (commission) on marketplace bookings, can use the management tools (calendar, Direct bookings, contracts, income and expense records, reports) and shows its shop profile on the marketplace. Renters still pay XePrime the booking fee; tax withholding still applies under the Tax Policy for Owners.

purchase.heading: 4. Purchase and activation
purchase.body: The Shop chooses a plan and term and receives an invoice with a VietQR code. The plan is activated when reconciliation confirms the invoice has been paid in full, not when the Shop taps a button. Each vehicle type has only one open invoice at a time. XePrime records the time, account and version of these Terms when the Shop confirms the purchase.

term.heading: 5. Term and renewal
term.body: A plan's term starts on activation. The Shop renews by paying the next term's invoice before the current term ends; XePrime never charges automatically. XePrime sends a reminder before the expiry date.

upgrade.heading: 6. Mid-term upgrades
upgrade.body: When the Shop upgrades to a higher tier of the same vehicle type and chooses to apply it now, the current term ends at the moment the new plan is activated; the Shop pays the full price of the new plan, and the remaining time of the old term is neither refunded nor deducted from the new price. This is shown before the Shop confirms.

expiry.heading: 7. Expiry, grace period and switching tracks
expiry.body: When a plan expires without being renewed:

items.grace: The Shop has a grace period (currently 7 days) to renew and keeps the plan's benefits during it.
items.track: When the grace period ends, the Shop moves to the pay-per-trip owner track: the owner service fee applies to trips accepted from then on, the vehicle creation limit of that track (up to 3 vehicles) applies and the advanced management tools are hidden.
items.existing: Existing vehicles are not removed from the Shop; trips locked before the switch keep the fees and policies already locked.
items.records: The Shop can still see its money, Points wallet, invoices, handover records, tax records and trips in progress.

refund.heading: 8. Refunds
refund.body: Plan fees paid are not refundable, except when XePrime fails to provide the service through its own fault or the law provides otherwise. Where a refund is due, it corresponds to the period the service was not provided.

verification.heading: 9. Verification of the business entity
verification.body: Paying for a plan does not mean the Shop has been verified. XePrime may request the business registration certificate, tax code and representative details; the verified badge only appears once the documents have been checked.

obligations.heading: 10. Shop obligations
obligations.body: The Shop meets the business conditions required by law on its own (including transport business conditions for rentals with driver), is responsible for actions of its staff accounts, protects renters' data and meets the tax obligations on its revenue.

suspension.heading: 11. Suspension and termination
suspension.body: XePrime may suspend or terminate a plan when the Shop seriously breaches the Marketplace Operating Rules or the law, after giving the reason and an opportunity to respond (except in an emergency or at the request of a competent authority). A plan terminated for the Shop's breach is not refunded for the remaining period.

changes.heading: 12. Changes to prices and terms
changes.body: XePrime may change plan prices and these Terms. New prices apply to billing terms after the effective date; terms already paid are not affected. Changes are announced at least 7 days in advance.
